title: My experiences in Mall World
content: In the literal sense, I do happen to have a considerably high amount of dreams that occur in a Mall, that I have visited over the course of many different dreams. This is a actual pretty typical shopping mall. Sometimes I am just walking around there are crowds, I am usually with a companion. IN of these dreams, I realized I was working at this mall, and was in a boardroom type room with a group of other employees. An active shooter situation went down and it was a nightmare of escaping. In the more general sense, I have a few apocalyptic type dreams in which everyone is ordered into a large industrial building which is "shelter from nuclear attack/some attack). We are made to live and work inside the place and have uniforms that are silver, sometimes without shoes I remember once trying to escape through a storm drain.
